blind.description: An ornate classical wingback armchair featuring a carved brown wooden frame with cabriole legs, decorative scrolling on the crest rail and armrests, and studded trim. The upholstery is a deep red patterned damask fabric covering the seat cushion, backrest, and padded armrests. Surfaces are completely solid, smooth, and continuous with no floating, melted, or missing geometry.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an armchair with a curved wooden top rail at the back, thick padded armrests flanking a central red seat cushion, and an overall roughly square silhouette.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
